{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Beverages|Beverages]]

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Tahini|tahini]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]] or other vegan [[Cookbook:Sweeteners|sweetener]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] or [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]] 
==Procedure==
# Roughly combine ingredients.
# Process with a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] until smooth.
# Chill for several hours.
# Stir before serving.
 
== Notes, tips, and variations == 
*This will keep in the refrigerator 4–5 days
